correctness.rationale: Homotopy of arbitrary continuous circle sensors yields integral winding rows v and vA; degree equals Q_A by cup product. Invariance of domain makes injective torus self-map a homeomorphism, so degree ±1 is necessary. A unimodular character delay is a homeomorphism, proving sufficiency. Cayley–Hamilton gives companion conjugacy. For the explicit examples identical characteristic polynomials and the exact identity 8Q=(4m+n)²+23n² establish the different observation behaviors. Positive C1 robustness follows from a degree-one local diffeomorphism covering argument. All computations were checked symbolically and with the packaged exact verifier; finite testing does not prove universal quantifiers.

value.rationale: Natural complete classification for the minimum two-sample, one-circle-sensor reconstruction of an evolving 2-torus. It detects a sharp topological arithmetic obstruction invisible to entropy, every periodic-point count, and Bernoulli measure isomorphism; explicit expanding matrices with identical spectra lie on opposite sides. The result is global and applies to arbitrary nonlinear continuous sensors, with a stable C1 positive case and a homotopy-invariant negative case.
